description: This file defines the HeapMemoryAllocator class, which implements a memory allocator for heap memory in Apache Spark. It manages memory blocks using pooling for small allocations and handles allocation and deallocation of long[] arrays.

classes.name: HeapMemoryAllocator
classes.description: A heap memory allocator that manages memory blocks using JVM long[] arrays with pooling for efficiency.

methods.name: allocate
methods.description: Allocates a memory block of the specified size, using pooling for small sizes.

methods.name: free
methods.description: Frees a previously allocated memory block, returning it to the pool if applicable.

methods.name: shouldPool
methods.description: Determines if a given size should be pooled based on the threshold.
